tithi.name: Shukla Shashthi
tithi.description: Sacred day dedicated to Lord Surya and Chhathi Maiya, highly auspicious for discipline, fasting, and spiritual elevation.

Mesha.summary: Professional endeavors gather strong momentum with prominent public recognition.
Mesha.general: The Moon transiting your tenth house bestows leadership acumen and purpose. You will navigate responsibilities with calm efficiency and dignity.
Mesha.career: Superior authorities appreciate your decisive contributions and organized strategy. A fruitful platform opens up for long-term project planning.
Mesha.finance: Monetary inflows remain steady through professional rewards and previous endeavors. Avoid premature investments in unverified speculative channels.
Mesha.relationships: Balancing career demands with domestic commitments deepens trust and harmony. Family elders offer blessings and valuable practical advice.
Mesha.health: Vitality is robust, though knee or joint strain needs mild stretching. Stay mindful of ergonomic posture during prolonged sitting.
Mesha.remedy: Offer water mixed with red sandalwood and jaggery to Lord Surya at sunrise.

Vrishabha.summary: Fortune smiles through philosophical pursuits, higher guidance, and intellectual breakthroughs.
Vrishabha.general: A spiritual aura envelops your day as the ninth house Moon aligns your focus with wisdom. Important decisions taken today bear long-lasting positive fruit.
Vrishabha.career: Mentors and senior colleagues provide strategic clarity for upcoming goals. Intellectual discussions and legal matters tilt favorably in your direction.
Vrishabha.finance: Financial stability strengthens through prudent planning and virtuous investments. Modest gains arrive through past academic or advisory consultancy.
Vrishabha.relationships: Meaningful conversations bring you closer to elders and philosophical mentors. Your calm demeanor resolves any subtle misunderstandings with your spouse.
Vrishabha.health: General wellbeing is favorable, fostering an upbeat mental state. Maintain mindful eating habits to support healthy digestion.
Vrishabha.remedy: Chant the Gayatri Mantra 11 times facing East during morning hours.

Mithuna.summary: Deep introspection and prudent caution unlock hidden inner strengths today.
Mithuna.general: With the Moon traveling through your eighth house, embrace contemplative calm rather than haste. Cultivating patience allows you to manage sudden schedule changes with grace.
Mithuna.career: Avoid initiating high-risk professional changes or confrontational dialogues today. Focus on meticulous research, back-office reviews, and audits.
Mithuna.finance: Scrutinize pending bills and joint financial liabilities with extreme care. Refrain from signing financial agreements without thorough validation.
Mithuna.relationships: Emotional sensitivity may run high; respond with patience rather than reactionary words. Compassionate listening will prevent domestic discord.
Mithuna.health: Prioritize restorative rest and hydration to alleviate seasonal sluggishness. Mindful breathing exercises help disperse lingering mental tension.
Mithuna.remedy: Apply a chandan tilak on your forehead and recite 'Om Namah Shivaya'.

Karka.summary: Partnerships thrive as shared aspirations find collaborative harmony and clear expression.
Karka.general: Your sign ruler illuminates the seventh house, enhancing mutual understanding and social magnetism. Collaborative alliances both in life and work yield pleasant outcomes.
Karka.career: Joint ventures and collaborative negotiations progress on remarkably productive terms. Your persuasive communication ensures fruitful consensus with stakeholders.
Karka.finance: Financial gains arise through collaborative trades or commercial partnerships. Keep domestic spending aligned with shared household budgets.
Karka.relationships: Marital warmth and romantic connections experience genuine closeness and tenderness. An evening spent together creates cherished memories.
Karka.health: Vital energy is solid, though adequate hydration is essential. Avoid heavy evening meals to support smooth digestion.
Karka.remedy: Offer raw milk and white flowers to a Shivling with sincere devotion.

Simha.summary: A triumph over obstacles and renewed daily discipline empower your productivity.
Simha.general: The Moon in your sixth house grants courage to surmount hurdles and organize daily routines. Your steady focus turns potential challenges into stepping stones.
Simha.career: You outshine competitors through meticulous execution and unmatched resilience. Pending workplace tasks reach completion ahead of planned timelines.
Simha.finance: Prudent budget management curtails unnecessary expenditures effectively. Favorable conditions assist in resolving small debts or dues.
Simha.relationships: Practical assistance extended to loved ones demonstrates your quiet commitment. Maintain gentle speech during household discussions.
Simha.health: Adopt wholesome dietary habits to maintain peak vitality. Engaging in brisk morning walks will boost your stamina.
Simha.remedy: Recite the Aditya Hridaya Stotra during sunrise for vigor and clarity.

Kanya.summary: Creative inspiration and emotional clarity bring delightful breakthroughs in learning and expression.
Kanya.general: The fifth house transit of the Moon sparks your intellect and artistic discernment. Engaging in creative hobbies or learning endeavors will bring immense satisfaction.
Kanya.career: Innovative solutions crafted by you earn applause from colleagues and clients. Strategic ideas shared in team forums find swift approval.
Kanya.finance: Speculative ventures should be approached with disciplined analysis, not impulsive optimism. Wise budgeting yields comfort and financial peace.
Kanya.relationships: Romantic connections flourish with joyful communication and thoughtful gestures. Children or younger kin bring moments of genuine pride.
Kanya.health: Mental cheerfulness promotes physical wellbeing and vitality. Engage in light yoga to maintain overall flexibility.
Kanya.remedy: Offer Durva grass to Lord Ganesha while chanting 'Om Gan Ganapataye Namah'.

Tula.summary: Focus turns toward domestic bliss, comfort, and rejuvenating your emotional roots.
Tula.general: With the Moon transiting the fourth house, finding inner tranquility and home harmony takes priority. Creating an organized living space soothes your mind.
Tula.career: Maintain steady focus on ongoing responsibilities without overextending commitments. Remote tasks or foundational planning yield the best outcomes today.
Tula.finance: Expenditures on home embellishment or family needs remain well within limits. Focus on establishing conservative, long-term asset growth.
Tula.relationships: Spending quality time with your mother or maternal figures brings deep emotional healing. Warm family discussions strengthen mutual trust.
Tula.health: Watch out for mild chest heaviness or seasonal cough due to climate shifts. Warm herbal infusions will keep your respiratory channels clear.
Tula.remedy: Light a ghee lamp in the temple of your home and chant the Sri Suktam.

Vrischika.summary: Courageous communication and purposeful initiatives yield commendable achievements.
Vrischika.general: The third house Moon activates enterprise, decisive vigor, and harmonious communication. Your self-confidence inspires trust among peers and siblings alike.
Vrischika.career: Short work-related communications, pitches, and writing endeavors prove fruitful. Collaborative efforts thrive under your proactive guidance.
Vrischika.finance: Financial gains through short travels or digital commercial channels look promising. Strategic investments in skill enhancement will pay high dividends.
Vrischika.relationships: Siblings and close neighbors provide heartfelt cooperation and cheer. Candid, uplifting conversations enhance relationship bonds.
Vrischika.health: Energy levels remain remarkably high throughout the day. Channel this physical stamina into an active workout or brisk walk.
Vrischika.remedy: Feed birds with soaked grains and chant the Hanuman Chalisa.

Dhanu.summary: Financial stability and eloquent speech enhance family prosperity and personal prestige.
Dhanu.general: The Moon moving through your second house highlights resource consolidation and refined speech. Your thoughtful words foster peace across both personal and professional spheres.
Dhanu.career: Presentations and negotiations conducted today yield favorable commitments. Your dependable work ethic draws constructive attention from management.
Dhanu.finance: Accumulated savings show a healthy trend through mindful expense management. An overdue financial payment or gift may pleasantly arrive.
Dhanu.relationships: Family gatherings or meals together radiate warmth and shared values. Your loving presence dissolves past lingering domestic tensions.
Dhanu.health: Pay attention to oral and throat care by drinking warm water. A wholesome, balanced vegetarian diet keeps you refreshed.
Dhanu.remedy: Apply a saffron or turmeric tilak on your forehead after bathing.

Makara.summary: Self-assurance, poise, and personal magnetic presence define your aura today.
Makara.general: With the Moon transiting your lagna, mental clarity and self-confidence reach peak levels. You lead by example and inspire those around you with calm grace.
Makara.career: Your strategic vision allows you to handle critical tasks effortlessly. Colleagues look up to your composure under tight deadlines.
Makara.finance: Personal investments and savings strategies show promising long-range security. Prudent self-discipline prevents unnecessary retail indulgences.
Makara.relationships: Your emotional balance brings assurance and warmth to your partner. Kind, clear communication dissolves any ambiguities in relationships.
Makara.health: Vitality is elevated, though mental quietude must be guarded against overthinking. A brief meditation session restores inner equilibrium.
Makara.remedy: Light a sesame oil lamp near a Peepal tree in the evening.

Kumbha.summary: Restful retreat, introspection, and spiritual pursuits bring deep mental rejuvenation.
Kumbha.general: The Moon in your twelfth house invites you to step back from bustling routines and rest. Quiet reflection will provide essential answers to complex questions.
Kumbha.career: Avoid taking on spontaneous commitments or entering contentious debates today. Focus on completing background tasks and planning future strategies privately.
Kumbha.finance: Watch out for unexpected domestic or philanthropic expenditures. Maintain a disciplined check on online impulse shopping.
Kumbha.relationships: Empathy and silence speak louder than words in resolving minor interpersonal friction. Solitude provides clarity before addressing important relationship discussions.
Kumbha.health: Ensure sound sleep and reduce late-night screen exposure to rest your eyes. Gentle breathing techniques will ease nervous exhaustion.
Kumbha.remedy: Donate warm clothing or food to an underprivileged person.

Meena.summary: Aspirations manifest as social networks and well-wishers rally to support your ambitions.
Meena.general: The Moon illuminating your eleventh house brings celebration, gains, and rewarding social engagements. Desired outcomes align smoothly with your sustained efforts.
Meena.career: Collaborative achievements and community goodwill boost your professional reputation. Networking leads to exciting avenues for future career expansion.
Meena.finance: Financial gains arrive through multiple channels or previous professional efforts. An investment made in the past starts showing promising returns.
Meena.relationships: Friendships bring genuine delight, camaraderie, and insightful perspectives. Romantic bonds flourish with joyful sharing of mutual dreams.
Meena.health: High spirits and positive energy keep physical fatigue at bay. Enjoy moderate outdoor activity to maintain physical vitality.
Meena.remedy: Chant the Brihaspati Beej Mantra 'Om Gram Greem Groum Sah Gurave Namah' 19 times.

tithi.name: Shukla Saptami
tithi.description: Auspicious tithi dedicated to Lord Surya, ideal for health, vigor, and spiritual dawn rituals.

Mesha.summary: Social alliances bring unexpected career gains and uplifting momentum today.
Mesha.general: The 11th house Moon stimulates your ambitions and encourages fruitful networking across diverse domains. Collaborative efforts will yield tangible joy and collective triumph.
Mesha.career: Your ideas will receive enthusiastic backing from senior peers and mentors. It is an optimal day to pitch joint initiatives or expand team projects.
Mesha.finance: Financial gains through past investments or pending dues are strongly highlighted. Avoid impulsive indulgence in luxury electronics.
Mesha.relationships: Meaningful conversations with friends will reignite your inner motivation. A romantic partner offers heartfelt encouragement for your long-term goals.
Mesha.health: Vitality is elevated, though minor stiffness in the calves or ankles may arise. Light stretching and hydration will maintain your energetic balance.
Mesha.remedy: Offer raw milk mixed with water to a Shiva Lingam while chanting 'Om Namah Shivaya'.

Vrishabha.summary: Professional accomplishments take center stage as your dedication receives deserved recognition.
Vrishabha.general: With the Moon illuminating your 10th house, leadership qualities and public standing receive a radiant boost. Focus on structured execution to make lasting impressions.
Vrishabha.career: Superior authorities will admire your systematic approach and steady composure under pressure. An unexpected career advancement conversation could open up.
Vrishabha.finance: Financial prospects remain steady with promising avenues for professional growth. Avoid speculative bets and rely on verified assets.
Vrishabha.relationships: Balancing long working hours with family expectations will require conscious tact. A warm, understanding gesture will reassure your domestic partners.
Vrishabha.health: Mental clarity is sharp, but ensure you do not skip balanced meals during busy hours. Maintain upright posture to ease lower-back strain.
Vrishabha.remedy: Chant the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra 11 times and offer white flowers to Lord Shiva.

Mithuna.summary: Fortune smiles on intellectual ventures, travel plans, and higher learning pursuits.
Mithuna.general: The 9th house Moon expands your worldview and invites philosophical tranquility. Your optimistic perspective attracts fortunate synchronicities throughout the day.
Mithuna.career: Academic pursuits, publishing, or international correspondence yield productive outcomes. Trust your intuitive wisdom when resolving ambiguous project guidelines.
Mithuna.finance: Financial prospects look promising, especially through consultancy or mentorship roles. Moderate spending on self-enrichment or books is well justified.
Mithuna.relationships: You will enjoy soulful discussions with family elders or your spouse. Open communication dissolves recent misunderstandings effortlessly.
Mithuna.health: Emotional resilience brings deep vitality and a sense of wellness. Spend time outdoors in the morning sunlight to harmonize mental energy.
Mithuna.remedy: Feed soaked green gram (moong dal) or green fodder to a cow.

Karka.summary: A introspective day calling for patience, calm discernment, and emotional grounding.
Karka.general: The 8th house transit suggests turning inward and managing emotional sensitivities with grace. Avoid hasty decisions and allow complex situations to unfold naturally.
Karka.career: Work may require extra patience as minor delays or ambiguous directions test your adaptability. Focus on research, auditing, and behind-the-scenes duties.
Karka.finance: Exercise strict prudence regarding shared assets, loans, or sudden expenditure. Defer major financial commitments until planetary energies align better.
Karka.relationships: Vulnerability can deepen mutual trust if expressed without emotional accusations. Give your partner personal space to prevent unnecessary frictions.
Karka.health: Take care of your digestive fire and avoid rich or overly spicy foods. Gentle pranayama will soothe fluctuating nervous tensions.
Karka.remedy: Chant 'Om Som Somaya Namah' 108 times in the evening.

Simha.summary: Harmonious partnerships bring immense clarity and collaborative breakthroughs.
Simha.general: The Moon directly aspects your sign from the 7th house, infusing your interactions with warmth and poise. Collaborative contracts and reciprocal agreements will prosper.
Simha.career: Negotiations, client meetings, and joint business endeavors will move smoothly. Your charismatic leadership will guide team members toward a shared vision.
Simha.finance: Favorable terms can be agreed upon in trade, joint ventures, or contractual work. Keep expenditure on entertainment within budgeted limits.
Simha.relationships: Marital and romantic relationships sparkle with shared laughter and deep companionship. Singles may cross paths with someone exhibiting genuine integrity.
Simha.health: General vitality is vibrant, though adequate hydration is essential. Balance strenuous physical output with restorative relaxation.
Simha.remedy: Offer water mixed with red sandalwood powder to the rising Sun.

Kanya.summary: Productive momentum empowers you to master challenges and streamline daily routines.
Kanya.general: The 6th house Moon sharpens your analytical intellect and blesses you with victory over hurdles. Organized routines will dramatically elevate your productivity today.
Kanya.career: You will resolve complicated administrative or operational bottlenecks with ease. Colleagues will appreciate your pragmatic solutions and meticulous attention to detail.
Kanya.finance: A favorable day for settling pending debts or refining personal balance sheets. Prudent budgeting decisions will strengthen your financial foundation.
Kanya.relationships: Keep interactions supportive rather than overly critical of loved ones' minor faults. Small acts of practical care will speak louder than words.
Kanya.health: Energy levels remain stable, but take care of your gut health with fresh fiber. Avoid late dinners to guarantee restful sleep.
Kanya.remedy: Donate food or warm clothing to someone in need on this Monday.

Tula.summary: Creative inspiration and affectionate bonds illuminate your personal universe today.
Tula.general: With the 5th house Moon, your artistic intellect and inventive capacity flourish delightfully. Joyful self-expression will draw positive attention and admiration.
Tula.career: Original ideas will set your work apart in brainstorming sessions or presentations. Those in artistic, educational, or advisory sectors will experience immense productivity.
Tula.finance: Thoughtful speculative assessments can yield positive insights, but avoid greed. Allocating funds for children's development or educational tools brings contentment.
Tula.relationships: Romance is heightened with sweet moments of shared joy and understanding. Parents will find profound pride in their children's accomplishments.
Tula.health: Vitality is radiant, accompanied by a refreshed mindset. Channel excess creative energy into dance, yoga, or creative hobbies.
Tula.remedy: Apply a chandan (sandalwood) tilak on your forehead after morning bath.

Vrischika.summary: Nurture inner peace and domestic comfort while attending carefully to family needs.
Vrischika.general: The 4th house Moon urges you to find solace within your personal sanctuary. Prioritizing emotional security will allow you to recharge your inner strength.
Vrischika.career: Maintain steady diligence at work without getting entangled in office politics. Working from a calm, uncluttered space will elevate your efficiency.
Vrischika.finance: Expenses may center on home upgrades, vehicular maintenance, or domestic provisions. Ensure financial decisions are taken with family consensus.
Vrischika.relationships: Maternal figures play an uplifting role in offering reassuring counsel today. Gentle empathy will heal old domestic friction and foster genuine harmony.
Vrischika.health: Watch out for mild chest heaviness or seasonal respiratory sensitivity. Drinking warm herbal infusions like tulsi tea will prove very soothing.
Vrischika.remedy: Touch the feet of your mother or an elderly matriarch to seek blessings.

Dhanu.summary: Dynamic courage and clear communication unlock new avenues of enterprise.
Dhanu.general: The 3rd house Moon enhances your valor, agility, and communicative prowess. Short trips, correspondence, and bold initiatives are favorably blessed.
Dhanu.career: Your initiative will dismantle longstanding inertia in ongoing projects. Pitching new proposals or leading presentations will yield rewarding accolades.
Dhanu.finance: Modest short-term gains through networking and trade are highlighted today. Keep financial documentation organized to capitalize on sudden openings.
Dhanu.relationships: Bonds with siblings, cousins, and neighbors will be cheerful and supportive. An engaging message could rekindle warmth with an old companion.
Dhanu.health: Physical agility and stamina are at their peak. Engage in regular cardio or brisk morning walks to maintain high endurance.
Dhanu.remedy: Light a pure ghee diya in front of Lord Shiva and recite the Gayatri Mantra.

Makara.summary: Steadfast focus on material stability and family values brings substantial satisfaction.
Makara.general: The 2nd house Moon activates your resourcefulness and articulative charm. Measured speech and realistic planning will solidify your material foundations.
Makara.career: Your words carry authority, making this a splendid day for corporate negotiations. Consistent dedication to core responsibilities will impress key stakeholders.
Makara.finance: Wealth accumulation efforts receive constructive support; favorable for savings. Review recurring budgets and prune non-essential subscriptions.
Makara.relationships: Warm family dinners and heart-to-heart conversations strengthen emotional solidarity. Honor commitments made to family members to sustain trust.
Makara.health: Avoid throat irritants and excessively cold beverages. Practicing mindful breathing will keep your voice melodious and nervous system grounded.
Makara.remedy: Donate rice or white sesame seeds to a temple priest or needy individual.

Kumbha.summary: Embrace personal reinvention as the Moon enhances your intuition, confidence, and magnetism.
Kumbha.general: With the Moon gracing your Janma Rashi, mental clarity and magnetic charm guide your actions. Channel this renewed self-assurance into meaningful individual aspirations.
Kumbha.career: You hold the center stage; your visionary insights will guide associates effectively. Trust your instinct when launching novel methods or reorganizing projects.
Kumbha.finance: Financial equilibrium is maintained through prudent judgment and conscious spending. A great day to outline investment blueprints for the coming quarter.
Kumbha.relationships: Your genuine warmth attracts affectionate appreciation from family and partner alike. Express your innermost dreams openly to foster mutual bonding.
Kumbha.health: Mental tranquility elevates your physical wellbeing and glow. Dedicate fifteen minutes to quiet meditation to center your thoughts.
Kumbha.remedy: Pour clean water on the roots of a Peepal tree without touching it on Monday morning.

Meena.summary: A peaceful day favoring spiritual reflection, restorative rest, and budget discipline.
Meena.general: The 12th house Moon encourages conscious withdrawal from outward chaos into restful introspection. Cultivating calm acceptance will transform stress into spiritual wisdom.
Meena.career: Focus on tasks requiring solitude, creative imagination, or foreign connections. Postpone aggressive negotiations until your energy levels fully recalibrate.
Meena.finance: Watch out for unexpected expenditures related to healthcare, travel, or charity. Maintain strict tracking of electronic transactions to avoid overshooting budgets.
Meena.relationships: You may crave quiet solitude, which should be communicated gently to your loved ones. Avoid overanalyzing past interactions or dwelling on perceived slights.
Meena.health: Prioritize deep sleep and rest for your eyes to alleviate fatigue. Soothing instrumental music before bedtime will ensure peaceful slumber.
Meena.remedy: Place a few drops of rosewater in your evening bath water and pray for universal peace.
